We need to call out this decision by the International Olympic Committee and Kirsty Coventry for what it truly is: a devastating attack on bodily autonomy, human rights, and inclusion. By banning transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category of events at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games, the establishment is weaponizing exclusion against vulnerable, marginalized groups under the cynical guise of protecting "fairness and safety." 

When Coventry states, “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category,” it exposes the bio-essentialist ideology driving this discriminatory policy. Instead of tackling structural inequities, the IOC is pandering to prejudice and reinforcing harmful divisions. This regressive move proves that the fight for intersectional justice in athletics faces immense hurdles against institutional gatekeepers who want to police who belongs.
